transcript: A modern corporation spends a great deal on advertising in order to make its brand known to as many people as possible Through media such as television, newspapers, magazines and the internet, countless advertisements reach us every day The purpose of an advertisement is to attract the attention of the consumer and persuade consumers to make a purchase The image of a brand just as much as the quality of a product has influence over our choice Since the appearance of social media, consumers themselves have been able to broadcast their opinions to the world An opinion against a certain brand can spread across the internet within hours in the image of a corporation may shift overnight. Governments too have established regulations to protect consumers from misleading advertising. For example, products related to health may not make any claim without solid evidence. Today's consumption, society binds corporations, consumers, and the state in a triangular relationship in which each watches the others. We ourselves are required to keep a critical eye on what we are shown.
